publication.reason: User-adopted writing-block.md requires separate approval for external publication.

model_routes.scope: Same world action API with ordinary movement/fire/jump/grenade; UI transition/boss-dialog acknowledgements adapted at their normal boundaries. No invulnerability, enemy removal, teleport progression or damage injection. Not browser/physical-device playthroughs.

secret_approaches.scope: Isolated authored approach fixtures retain actual pits/platforms and use jump/charge/fire. Hostiles removed; not full missions.

native_render.scope: Authored visual fixtures, not ordinary full playthroughs.

firefox.scope: Actual browser input, emulated touch/viewports; no state setters or save injection. No guided-input file was used.

chromium.scope: Actual rescue, touch/multitouch, rotation, persistence and offline reopening; full post-fix Chromium mission NOT TESTED.

audio_regression.scope: Instrumented WebAudio counters preserve original methods. This is not a physical audio listening test.

performance.status: FAIL for 60 FPS in this measured software environment; physical targets NOT TESTED

measurement.scope: Actual active mission, standing after a rescue; motion enabled. Not a physical phone or peak-load certification.

environment_memory.scope: Whole review environment; one browser and overlapping headless source/model checks after the six-second frame-time sample. Not browser-only or phone RAM.

lifecycle.scope: Headless node/orphan lifetime; not GPU/WASM peak memory.

packaging.scope: 7 web contracts + 4 Android packet fixtures + 3 mocked macOS hdiutil/retry fixtures. No new installed platform package is implied.

not_tested: Physical Poco X7 / iPhone / Xbox / PlayStation controller
9–13 minute human exploration target; fast automated mission was about five minutes
New signed Android/iOS packages; new Windows/macOS/Linux installers
Full mission in current Chromium candidate
Professional Foley/mix on speakers or headphones
known_content_limits: Legacy skimmer has no newly drawn wreck atlas; the three new vehicles do.
Secret areas use raised side-platform rooms; fully separate submerged/underground tunnel scenes are not implemented.
New art and lore are TASLAK, without owner canon/art approval.
diagnostics: Earlier model controller runs failed and are retained; the final 18-case run passes.
Pre-fix Firefox hit the 16 GiB environment limit and was OOM-killed; pre-fix Chromium consumed high memory and its stalled run was stopped.
A requested OpenGL ANGLE diagnostic backend lacked WebGL2 in this environment; it did not run the game.
Paused/looping music was being repeatedly started. Boundary-only starts and stream playback removed repeated long WebAudio samples; the final full Firefox run had no new OOM event.
